component.name: Recrest
component.summary: Developer dashboard for local repos, pull requests and CI

description.p: Recrest surfaces every git repository on your machine, its working-tree status, the open pull requests that belong to it, and the CI checks that gate them — in one native desktop window instead of a browser, a terminal and three Electron apps.

Repositories are read directly from disk, so the local view keeps working offline. Nothing is sent anywhere unless you open a remote pull request: there is no telemetry, no cloud sync and no Recrest server. Access tokens are stored in the operating system keyring, never on disk in plain text.

ul.li: Filesystem scan for local repositories with live branch, ahead/behind and dirty state
Pull and merge requests from GitHub, GitLab and Bitbucket, with diffs and inline comments
CI and pipeline runs, workflow triggers, and deployment status per repository
Activity insights: commit history, author leaderboards, streaks, time-to-merge and a language breakdown, all computed locally
Command palette and keyboard-first navigation
Light, dark and system themes; English and German user interface
Built to WCAG 2.1 AA

description.p: Authentication uses personal access tokens (GitHub, GitLab) or app passwords (Bitbucket). OAuth is not available yet.

screenshot.caption: Repository list with the repository detail pane open

ul.li: Interface scaling rebuilt: zoom shortcuts, an interface-size slider, and correct rendering on HiDPI Wayland sessions
Linux packaging moved to .deb, .rpm and the AUR; the AppImage was dropped
Linux updates now come from your package manager instead of the in-app updater
Window size and position are kept inside the visible screen area on restore
Landing page overhaul with an interactive, seeded live demo of the app
Privacy, accessibility and imprint pages
Fixed live repository refresh and Apple Silicon builds that could not be opened
Fixed the Linux bundle build against freedesktop-desktop-entry 0.7.19
Fixed the packaged app rendering completely unstyled, caused by the build-time Content-Security-Policy nonce disabling the inline-style allowance that the UI toolkit relies on
Fixed a cold-boot regression on Windows and Linux where the first frame stayed unstyled until a manual reload
Fixed the Linux installer build against the freedesktop-desktop-entry 0.7.19 API change
Added a "Pull all" dashboard quick action
Restyled the activity chart and made the language-mix card scale with its container
Enforced the 1100x720 minimum window size at runtime on Windows
